question: Which nature reserve is nearest when considering the south direction of Central Florida Zoo & Botanical Gardens, Sanford, FL?
sql:
WITH origin AS (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.314867 28.825462)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois,origin
WHERE pois.leisure = 'nature_reserve'
AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> origin.geometry ASC
LIMIT 1;

answers.poi_name: Lake Wales Ridge Wildlife and Environmental Area - Carter Creek

[2].display_name: Central Florida Zoo & Botanical Gardens, Sanford, FL
